title: Website Tech, SEO & AI-Readiness Check
description: Check websites' tech stack, metadata, SEO basics, robots.txt AI-bot rules, sitemap and llms.txt.

urls.title: Websites
urls.description: Domains or URLs (e.g. example.com or https://example.com/page). One row per unique URL.

checkRobots.title: Check robots.txt & AI bots
checkRobots.description: Fetch robots.txt and report allow/block status for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot and more.

checkSitemap.title: Check sitemap
checkSitemap.description: Find the XML sitemap (robots.txt Sitemap: or /sitemap.xml) and count URLs.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skip pages that robots.txt disallows for generic crawlers (recommended).

maxSites.title: Max sites
maxSites.description: Safety cap on unique URLs per run.
